title: Renting Vs Buying a Home - The Real Math
description:
Is it better to rent or buy a home? 
The answer is more complicated than “rent is throwing money away.” 

In this video, we break down the real math behind renting vs buying a house and follow two people over 20 years to see which decision builds more wealth.

In this video, we compare:
Mortgage payments vs rent 
Home equity vs stock market investments 
Mortgage interest and principal 
Property taxes and homeowners insurance 
Home maintenance and repair costs 
Rent increases over time 
Home price appreciation 
Investment compound growth 
Closing and transaction costs 
Opportunity cost of a down payment 
Liquidity and diversification 
The price-to-rent ratio 
The behavioural advantage of forced saving 
What happens when a renter actually invests the difference 

Buying can provide stability, leverage, long-term housing control and a path to substantial home equity. Renting can provide flexibility, liquidity and the opportunity to keep more money invested in financial markets.
But both strategies have a condition attached.
